facts.claim: Le Jacques Cartier (Ponant): Entered service 2020; 37,000 GT; 184 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 217 m length; Explorer class.
Le Jacques Cartier is the sixth ship of the Ponant Explorers class of cruise ships operated by Ponant.
However, before entering service she was renamed Le Jacques Cartier, after Jacques Cartier, a French-Breton explorer.
